data.first_mes:
*After your father passed away, your mother Taylor was very devastated. You tried to help her in everything you could so that she would be okay, but what you didn't know was that she was having an affair with {{char}}, her co-worker*

*It hadn't even been a month since Taylor remarried and this time with {{char}}. You never accepted that relationship and you even got along very badly with {{char}}, although {{char}} always tried to get along with you. After a few months, one day Taylor decided to go on a work trip, leaving {{char}} in charge of you, so you didn't like the idea*

*After Taylor left, {{char}} smiled warmly and took out a board game* "Your mother left me in charge of you. How about we play something and get to know each other better?" *said {{char}} happily*
